why: DNSSEC Steward is one end-to-end workflow, not a set of independent modules. It ships only when the whole workflow is proven from a clean install, under regression testing.

gates.title: Failover drill
gates.pass: Forced promotion and rejoin pass, with the time to signing measured
gates.evidence: Forced promotion to signer2 committed in 34 s; a NOTIFY then brought ns1, ns2 and ns3 up to date in 1 s; ns1 and ns3 rejoined, ns3's own signing discarded; zone-reg.net validated throughout. Found and fixed on the way: standby user IDs, the signer profile, a leftover agent holding signer2's database, signer2's notification source, catalog thaw, and NOTIFY refused at forwarded ports since 4.22.

gates.title: Failback
gates.pass: Signing returns home through the normal, receipt-based handoff
gates.evidence: Signing returned to ns3 at epoch 10 through the receipt-based handoff; all four servers in step; ns2 now follows ns3 by notification (first time since 4.22). Found and fixed on the way: replica database installed beside a stale journal (recovered intact), the forced path's missing confirm step, the handover probe still using retired .195 and probing a same-site signer, a variable shadowing in 7.0's probe patch, the repoint check for four-member clusters, and secondaries lagging after the weekly serial tick.

gates.title: Open items closed
gates.pass: Build queue uniqueness rule aligned; the two readiness copies reconciled
gates.evidence: Release 7.3: the build queue no longer treats a shared public address as a conflict, so two servers can be built at one site (hostname, LAN and installation addresses stay unique; 5 tests). The dead application copy of the readiness verdict was removed, and the live library copy, which every service loads, now has 11 tests. 42 tests passed on Steward; both Stewards proven to hold the same manifest.

gates.title: Steward installer
gates.pass: A Steward builds from the image on a clean node, on either CPU architecture

gates.title: Site data separated from code
gates.pass: Addresses, credentials and registrar settings are configuration; nothing of this cluster is in the repository

gates.title: eng.quest live
gates.pass: eng.quest signed by Steward with its DS at .quest kept by Porkbun's API; a child name.eng.quest delegated, its DS published automatically by API and by CDS

gates.title: Clean-room install
gates.pass: A fresh lab cluster, built only from the repository, signs lab.eng.quest end to end with a public chain of trust

gates.title: Full regression on the lab
gates.pass: Build, join, swap, unpublish, rollover, handoff, failover, rejoin and failback all pass in one run

gates.title: Documentation
gates.pass: Install, operate, recover, and the architecture
